image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a thick, metallic chain composed of interlinked oval rings. The chain is silver-colored with high reflectivity and metallic luster. It runs diagonally across the frame from bottom-left to top-right. The background is a soft, out-of-focus grey/white gradient. The links appear tightly packed, creating a complex pattern of highlights and shadows.

The distinction between one link passing through another is lost in several areas; they appear as a solid, undulating mass rather than discrete interlocked rings.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Multiple adjacent links appear to melt into one another. The negative space (holes) inside the rings is inconsistent, with some holes partially filled by the 'metal' of neighboring links, violating physical topology.
The depth of field falloff is unnatural. Links just slightly behind the focal plane lose all geometric definition and become smeared blobs rather than optically blurred rings.
The chain seems to emerge from or merge into the white background without a clear boundary or attachment point, suggesting a generation boundary error.
